description: Fresh precision benchmark written after verifier prompt v8 was frozen. Never used for tuning; use for the final unbiased estimate.
changelog: 1.0.0 — 17 unseen cases: 12 clean hard negatives and 5 clear fallacies, with surface forms not used in earlier sets or prompt examples.
